**sdd/issue-246-c3/apply-progress**

**What**: Implemented the `plainfiles` memory backend (C3, issue #246) — all 36/36 tasks across Phases 1-6 complete, single batch, single PR (no chain). `.memory/records/*.jsonl` becomes a real second `MEMORY_BACKEND` inhabitant with save/search/share/pull/setup; index/featureCheckpoint/featureResume defer via a shared `unsupportedOp` helper; `engram`'s cli save/search doors refuse loudly too (never-cryptic on both backends, obs #578). PLUS 2 MINOR fixes from a fresh-context post-implementation review (no blockers found; provenance spoof-resistance, round-trip, budget all held).

**Why**: sdd/issue-246-c3/tasks (obs #581), spec.md (REQ-C3-1..6), design.md, and the binding owner ruling obs #578. The 2 MINOR fixes came from a fresh-context adversarial review after the initial apply.

**Where** (new files):
- `brain/scripts/memory/backends/plainfiles.mjs` (225 lines) — save/search/share/pull/setup + 3 deferral stubs.
- `brain/scripts/memory/lib/unsupported-op.mjs` (24 lines) — shared `unsupportedOp(op, backend, {key, params})` helper.
- Test files: `plainfiles.{save,search,share,pull,setup,unsupported,actorkind-consistency}.test.mjs`, `cli.save-search.test.mjs`, `backends/engram.save-search-unsupported.test.mjs`, `lib/unsupported-op.test.mjs`, `lib/plainfiles-actorkind-doc-tripwire.test.mjs` (guard function INLINED here per task 3.4's sanctioned alternative), `lib/plainfiles-roundtrip.integration.test.mjs` (CP-C3 evidence).

**Where** (modified files):
- `brain/scripts/memory/lib/format.mjs` (+15) — new `nowUtcSeconds(getNow)` C2a canonical UTC-seconds clock.
- `brain/scripts/memory/backends/engram.mjs` (+19) — `save()`/`search()` refusal stubs pointing to native `mem_save`/`mem_search`.
- `brain/scripts/memory/cli.mjs` (+66) — VALID_OPS +save/search; save arg-parser; search post-dispatch print; `BRAIN_MEMORY_TEST_ROOT` test-only seam.
- `brain/scripts/i18n/en.mjs` + `es.mjs` (+12 each) — memory.op.unsupported / memory.save.engramUnsupported / memory.search.engramUnsupported / memory.plainfiles.save.{done,secretFound} / memory.save.plainfilesIgnoredOpts (MINOR 2) / memory.plainfiles.search.{empty,summary}.

**Budget**: authoritative non-test counted diff (git diff --numstat, governance ignoreList: `**/*.test.mjs`, `.memory/**`, `openspec/changes/**`, lockfiles) = **373 lines** (was 364 pre-review; MINOR 2 added +9; MINOR 1 was test-only). Comfortably under 400 — no C3a/C3b split, no size:exception.

**Post-review fixes (both RED→GREEN, both requested by a fresh-context reviewer)**:
1. **MINOR 1 — doc-scan tripwire had only partial teeth.** `INSTRUCTION_RE` caught only run/execute/ejecutar. Broadened (en+es) to also catch invoke/type/use/paste/corré/usá/pegá, PLUS a new `FENCE_RE` catching a BARE fenced code block containing the literal `memory save`/`MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles memory save` command with no imperative prose nearby. RED confirmed first (7 new bypass fixtures — invoke/use/type/paste/Spanish/fence — all uncaught by the old narrow regex). Fixed a real bug found while broadening: a trailing `\b` after an accented Spanish verb (`corré`) silently fails to match because `é` isn't a `\w` char in JS regex — replaced with a `(?![\wáéíóúñ])` lookahead. Also added a path-based exemption (`EXEMPT_PATH_RE = /^openspec\/changes\//`) so SDD planning artifacts (spec.md/design.md/tasks.md/proposal.md, which legitimately discuss `memory save` at length while specifying the feature) never trip the tripwire — mirrors the existing `openspec/changes/**` exclusion already used by the governance diff-size ignoreList. Confirmed via a dedicated proxy test that reads the REAL C3 openspec docs directly (since they're still untracked pre-merge, the default `git ls-files` seam doesn't see them yet) — proves the exemption will hold once tracked. 13/13 green including the live assertion over real tracked docs.
2. **MINOR 2 — save silently dropped scope/topic.** `plainfiles.mjs#save` now warns (via `console.warn` + a new i18n key `memory.save.plainfilesIgnoredOpts`, en+es) naming which of scope/topic were ignored and why, WITHOUT erroring (an error would break the `_defaultEngramSave` arg-shape parity the mirror exists for) and WITHOUT blocking the write (the record still saves normally). RED confirmed first (0 warnings when scope/topic passed). 2 new tests: warns exactly once naming both opts when both are passed; does NOT warn when both are absent.

**TDD evidence (original + review fixes)**: strict RED→GREEN for every code task and every review fix. Full original evidence unchanged (see below). Review fixes: doc-tripwire bypass tests RED (7 failures) → GREEN (13/13, zero regressions on the live real-docs assertion); save scope/topic warn RED (assertion `0 !== 1`) → GREEN (5/5 in plainfiles.save.test.mjs).

**Final gates (post-review)**: `npm test` **1269/1269** (was 1258 pre-review, +11: 9 tripwire bypass/exemption tests + 2 scope/topic warn tests). `brain:repo:check` clean. `brain:nav` clean. `brain:audit` shows the same 2 pre-existing `adrPresence` FAILs (04ae992, 8d60661) — unrelated, unchanged. Provenance (measured actor/actorKind/ts) and both round-trip directions re-verified green after the `save()` signature change (scope/topic now destructured for the warn check) — no regression.

**Learned**:
- `plainfiles.save()`/`search()` structurally CANNOT carry `issue`/`supersedes` (design's own buildRecord field list omits them) — the round-trip's supersedes-chain fixture lives on the engram→plainfiles leg only (§4-prose recovery), documented as design-consistent, not a gap.
- CLI dispatch needed a `BRAIN_MEMORY_TEST_ROOT` test-only env seam (mirrors `BRAIN_MIGRATE_V1_TEST_ROOT`) so subprocess-level CLI tests never touch the real repo's `.memory/`.
- JS regex `\b` word-boundary silently fails after non-ASCII accented characters (é, á, etc. are not `\w` without the `u`/unicode-property flag) — use a negative lookahead against an explicit accented-char class instead of relying on `\b` when matching multilingual (en+es) imperative verbs.
- CP-C3 posture unchanged: this apply run does NOT run `memory:share` or push — orchestrator's responsibility (task 6.3, same boundary as A3's CP-A3a).

Status: 36/36 tasks complete + 2/2 post-review MINOR fixes complete. Ready for sdd-verify / PR. No blockers.
